detail: 119 `lc` references in code spans and fenced blocks of prompts/*.md and .claude/skills/litcritic/**/*.md; every command and subcommand exists in the `lc` argparse parser (the full calls also parse, test_prompts_only_reference_existing_commands). The `lc index` loop is named in full: plan, packet, import (--next), status, cost, eval, compare, plan --changed.
decision: A place or group is an entity only if a scene happens there or it acts or recurs (named in 2 or more places); a passing mention is a reject. Stated in prompts/20-codex-items.md and in the entity packet instructions (packets.INSTRUCTIONS), pinned equal by test_mention_rule_matches_packet_instructions.
